subject.title: fix(web-fetch): extract full HTML body content

question: Should title-only Readability output keep the existing provider-before-basic-cleanup fallback order, even though that can invoke configured providers for pages that previously returned local title-only output?
rationale: The code path is a plausible focused fix, but fallback ordering affects compatibility, latency, and provider cost for existing installations, so automation should not choose that tradeoff.

options.title: Accept provider-first fallback
options.body: Merge with the current order, preserving the documented Readability to provider to basic cleanup sequence for the newly detected title-only case.

options.title: Switch title-only local-first
options.body: Ask the contributor to try body-scoped local cleanup before external provider fallback to minimize provider calls for this specific class.

options.title: Pause for extraction consolidation
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want the adjacent HTML conversion hardening PR to define the shared raw-cleanup direction first.

recommendation.title: Accept provider-first fallback
recommendation.body: Merge with the current order, preserving the documented Readability to provider to basic cleanup sequence for the newly detected title-only case.
